content.short: A comprehensive DeFi super app on Aptos unifying lending, borrowing, swapping, and margin trading in one interface.
content.description:
Aries Markets is a comprehensive "DeFi Super App" on the Aptos blockchain that unifies lending, borrowing, swapping, and margin trading into a single, intuitive interface. It features a Unified Margin Account that consolidates all DeFi activities, allowing for seamless cross-collateralization across different assets. This architecture provides users with maximum capital efficiency and a streamlined experience.

The platform includes an on-chain order book for high-speed margin trading and an "Efficiency Mode" (E-Mode) that optimizes borrowing power for correlated asset pairs. By leveraging Aptos' high throughput, Aries Markets delivers lightning-fast execution and a professional-grade DeFi suite.
